from.description: Object representing the authorized sender to appear in the "from" message header.

to[].description: Represents the recipients this message is directed to. At least one recipient must be indicated.

cc[].description: Represents recipients that will receive a carbon copy of the message

bcc[].description: Represents recipients that will receive a blind carbon copy of the message.

subject.description: The subject of the message. Strongly recommended to be properly assigned. Up to 144 characters long.

label.description: Optional message label up to 80 characters (UTF-8).

customHeaders[].description: Optional array containing up to 10  customHeader objects :{ "name" : "customHeader1Name", "value" : "customHeader1Value"}

customHeaders[].name.description: The name to be used for the custom header.

customHeaders[].value.description: The value to be assigned to the custom header.

content.description: This object has two properties indicating the content to be displayed for HTML enabled email clients and content to be displayed for text only email clients such as Alpine.

content.html.description: The full HTML containing your message body. Required property.

content.text.description: Optional property containing the text message to be used by text only email clients.

footer.description: Represents the footer to be added to HTML or Text versions of the message.

attachments[].description: Optional array containing attachments to be added to message MIME.

attachments[].filename.description: If attachments array is present, then for any objects contained in it,  the filename property must be a non empty string.

attachments[].type.description: If attachments array is present and not empty, this is one of the valid and acceptable MIME type. Please note that no executable files are allowed.

attachments[].content.description: This property contains the actual data in base64 format. If attachments array is present, then for all objects contained, the content must exist and be a valid base64 string.

scheduledDate.description: This property indicates the time and date this message has to be delivered ("YYYY-MM-DD**T**11:52:03.694**Z**"). It has to be at least 30 minutes after current date/time.

dsn.description: Optional delivery status notification provides the means to set the return address, event id and to set the events you are interested in.

dsn.orcpt.description: If dsn object is present, this property indicates the email address to sent notifications out.

dsn.envid.description: Optional property. Indicates a custom event id to be included in the notification. Used for SMTP layer automation mainly.

dsn.notify.description: If dsn object is indicated then notify property must exist. It is a comma separated field that indicates the occasions that a new status notification must be dispatched. Valid values are  FAILURE, DELAY, SUCCESS, NEVER. Please note that NEVER can not be combined with any other value.

callback.description: Optional object indicating the call-backs (web hooks) to be called.

callback.statusCallback.description: Optional object indicating which URL to be called and in what case.

callback.statusCallback.strategy.description: If the optional callback.statusCallback is present, strategy property indicates when the URL will be called. Possible values are "OnChange" asking the system to perform an http call every time the message changes status, and, "OnComplete" that instructs the system to perform the web hooks when a message reaches final state (i.e. no additional state changes are expected).

callback.statusCallback.url.description: If callback.statusCallback optional object is present, **url** property indicates which page is to be called. The system will perform a POST call to the indicated URL each callback.statusCallback.strategy occasion.

callback.eventCallback.description: Optional object containing instructions on which URL to call when the recipient Opens a message or when a link included in the message is clicked. Please note that recipient may be one of those who are included in bcc.

callback.eventCallback.onClick.description: Indicates the url to call when a recipient clicks on some link within the message body. if callback.eventCallback optional object is present then at least one of it two members must exist.

callback.eventCallback.onOpen.description: If callback.eventCallback object is present, this property indicates the url to be called when one recipient opens the message. Although it is optional property, the callback.eventCallback must not be empty, so if the callback.eventCallback.onClick is not set, then this property becomes required.
